about.title: It starts with curiosity.
about.body: Hi! I'm Faris. I work as an IT Support specialist and tester, so I'm used to handling technical issues and making sure applications run well. My goal is to become a Fullstack Developer, and I keep learning to develop my skills on both the frontend and backend. In my spare time, I enjoy working on fun personal projects — to me, coding is exciting, even when it's challenging.

experience.title: Experience in practice.
experience.label: EXPERIENCE
items: Provide technical support for ATR BPN applications used nationwide across Indonesia.
Handle and resolve technical issues for users across regions, from application troubleshooting to software installation.
Test ATR BPN applications to ensure quality before release, including writing test cases and reporting bugs.
Help test the Tataletak mapping application and document the results so the development team can fix issues quickly.

story.title: A little beyond the code.
story.label: PERSONAL STORY
paragraphs: I started my journey in IT as a self-taught learner — learning through hands-on practice, which helped me pick up new things quickly from the start. My day-to-day work in IT Support & QA sharpens my problem-solving instincts: every user issue is a puzzle to solve, and understanding where an application 'hurts' makes me want to build it properly even more. That's the reason behind my big goal: to become a Fullstack Developer and eventually build my own products.

In my spare time, I work on personal projects I enjoy. Beyond coding, I also enjoy playing games and hip hop music. For me, the best projects come from things I genuinely love, and there's no more enjoyable way to learn than that.
